faqs.question: What does Ebenezer Tarubinga do?
faqs.answer: AI/ML engineer and first-author researcher working across dense prediction and production LLM systems. Research spans semi-supervised semantic segmentation, pseudo-label reliability, uncertainty calibration and contrastive learning; engineering work spans hybrid RAG, knowledge-graph retrieval, tool-using agents, multi-provider model routing and edge vision.

faqs.question: What is his current role?
faqs.answer: AI/ML Engineer at Gractor in Seoul, Korea, since September 2025. I built hybrid retrieval for utility-operations data, a read-only tool-calling operations agent for water-grid workflows, multi-provider LLM routing with circuit-breaker failover and YOLOv5/OpenVINO edge detection, and hardened a road-infrastructure digital twin.

faqs.question: What does his research cover?
faqs.answer: Four first-author papers on semi-supervised semantic segmentation: CW-BASS (IEEE IJCNN 2025), FARCLUSS (Neural Networks, vol. 205), CW-BASS v2 (arXiv:2608.12773) and PixCon (arXiv:2607.03068, under review). The first two are MSc research at Korea University; the last two are independent research.

faqs.question: What is CW-BASS v2?
faqs.answer: A first-author paper on saturation-aware pseudo-label selection under foundation-model teachers (arXiv:2608.12773, 2026). It uses DINOv2-Base (ViT-B/14) with DPT-lite and a reliability gate evaluated across six DINOv2 teacher settings, and reaches 86.19 ± 1.82 mIoU on Pascal VOC 1/8 over three seeds.

faqs.question: What is PixCon?
faqs.answer: A first-author paper on clean-positive contrastive learning for foundation-model semi-supervised segmentation (arXiv:2607.03068, 2026), under review. The contrastive head is training-only and adds no inference-time parameters. On Pascal VOC 1/8 it reaches 87.90 mIoU (3-seed mean, versus 87.01 for the matched reproduction).

faqs.question: What has he released as open source?
faqs.answer: hwpkit: a pure-Python HWP/HWPX document reader and editor, published on PyPI. codexwatch: local-first Codex usage and token analytics. claudehop and codexhop: dependency-free Python utilities for switching Claude Code and OpenAI Codex accounts or provider profiles across terminals. Also tzohar-engine, a framework for personal and academic websites, and the code for the four papers.

faqs.question: What did he study and research at Korea University?
faqs.answer: An MSc in Artificial Intelligence, 2023–2026, GPA 3.78/4.0, advised by Prof. Seong-Whan Lee (IEEE Fellow). I was a Research Engineer in the Pattern Recognition & Machine Learning Lab from August 2023 to August 2025, hold the Global Korea Scholarship (sole Zimbabwean awardee) and a BK21 Research Fellowship, and contributed to a Korean patent application for real-time object detection.

faqs.question: Is he open to new work?
faqs.answer: Open to ML and research-engineer roles, and to research collaborations.
